appVersionNote: PUBLIC App Store version — not the version in simplememo-ios/project.pbxproj. That file reads MARKETING_VERSION 5.7.3, but release.yml ships tag -> Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight and its submit_review input defaults to false, so a built version is not a released one. 5.0.3 is the highest release this repo can evidence: /siri/ was merged with the note 'draft until 5.0.3 ships' and is now index,follow and listed in sitemap-ja.xml. Verify and bump with: curl -s 'https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp' | grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' — then edit this one field and run: node scripts/sync_constants.js --write
